tool_definitions.name: job
tool_definitions.description: run a shell command in the background. You will be notified automatically when it finishes.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: the job name; 1–10 characters from [a-z0-9-] (for all actions except 'list', 'prune')

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: the job names to watch for wait

parameters.name: wait_for
parameters.description: whether wait returns after any or all watched jobs end

parameters.name: wait_seconds
parameters.description: how many seconds to wait at most — max 270 (default)

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: the command line (for action 'start'); if omitted, re-runs previous job by name

event.text: Job names use one to ten lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.

payload.content: Job names use one to ten lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
